grafias_do_espelho: FORMER BIG BEND · UNDER KINBASKET LAKE
texto_aprovado: From there, the river does something odd for a river on its way to Oregon. It heads northwest, deeper into Canada. Then it swings around in a long hairpin, the river's big bend in British Columbia, and only after that does it turn south toward the border. That bend is underwater these days: it lies beneath a lake, behind one of the dams in this story. Keep your finger moving, and by the time the Columbia crosses into the United States, it has made a third or more of its whole journey to the sea.
